examples.english: Then I eat a small breakfast.

examples.arabic: هو مبسوط عشان الفطار طعمه حلو خالص.
examples.english: He is happy because the breakfast tastes very good.
examples.transliteration: Howa mabsoot ashaan el fitaar taamo helw khaales.

examples.english: I am eating a little breakfast.

examples.arabic: ماما ندهت عليا من المطبخ وقالت يالا يا حبيبي الفطار جاهز
examples.english: Mom called me from the kitchen and said 'Come on dear, breakfast is ready.'
examples.transliteration: Mama nadahet 3alaya men el matbakh we 'alet yalla ya 7abibi el fetar gahez

examples.english: I went to the kitchen to make breakfast.
examples.transliteration: Roht el matbakh ala shan a'mel fetar

examples.arabic: عملت فطار خفيف وجهزت نفسي عشان أصحابي جايين
examples.english: I made a light breakfast and got myself ready because my friends are coming.
examples.transliteration: 'Amelt fetar khafeef we gahhazt nafsi 'ashan aṣḥabi gayyeen.
